newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: FCL Energy Sept qtr production rises.
newsitem.headline: FCL Energy Sept qtr production rises.

text.p: Fletcher Challenge Energy on Tuesday said total production for the September quarter was 12.5 million barrels of oil equivalent (mmboe), up 11.0 percent on the same period in the 1995/96 year.
FCL Energy said New Zealand gas production was higher as a result of strong demand from gas-fired power stations and the commissioning of the Tariki/Ahuroa gas treatment plant.
It said 35 wells were drilled in Canada during the quarter, 24 of which were cased for a success rate of 69 percent.

The floating production and storage offloading vessel (FPSO) Whakaaropai was successfully commissioned with Fletcher Challenge Energy's share of daily oil production from the Maui F Sands averaging 13,000 barrels per day for September.
Drilling of the Maharaja Lela 3 appraisal well, (Brunei offshore) was completed, with the primary target J Sands producing 29 million cubic feet of gas and 444 barrels of condensate per day.
Manu 1 (New Zealand onshore) and Juragan 2A (Brunei offshore) commenced during the period. Awatea 1 (New Zealand offshore) was plugged and abandoned in October.
